name: Al Amma
overview: While Suleiman believed that five years of calm would be enough to bury the ashes of his terrifying past and overcome its effects, reality slaps him in the face when he realizes that those days were nothing but a false veil; the present he thought was safe is merely an extension of a nightmare It was not over yet, for he discovered that the real hell had never left, but was hiding in the corners of the past, lying in wait for the fatal moment to return and burn everything.
